scope: One additional rank-1 captured-trig/coordinate boundary before rotation multiplication.
description: On B/C acceptance, capture all four FP32 coordinates and cosine/sine together with the existing pair/rank/address/valid tags. A new ROTATE_MUL cycle computes the original eight FP32 products, followed by the existing ROTATE_ADD cycle. Keep ready low while the tagged pair is pending. Only the first N/4 rotating pairs use the extra cycle, adding 32 cycles/token. The recurrence pipeline is unchanged. Extend the tag monitor through ROTATE_MUL, check all six captured words, and test resets in both the captured-ROM and existing product stages. Quartus absorbs the trig registers into inferred synchronous-ROM address registers; phase_c is not a routed register name. The initial name-selector failure is retained under timing/initial-selector-*. Actual register selectors bind the phase-to-ROM-address and ROM-address-to-product segments. The registered-ROM inference increases M9Ks from 7 to 9 and logical memory bits from 29,792 to 46,176.
